submission.justification: Provisional recommendation only. The hard thermal-cycling constraint could not be verified for any design: none of the 6 documents contained thermal-cycling or failure data, and no design has a known failure fraction after 20 cycles (300 K to 87 K). Module-D2 is named because it has the highest prior light-collection figure in the records (38 PE/MeV at 20% coverage, versus 27 for D3 and 18 for D1). That figure is a 2025 prior, and this run did not simulate or re-measure any design, so the light-collection goal is also unverified. Coverage of 20% is inside the 5-30% window, but it was chosen only because the prior figure was quoted at 20%. Do not commit this design to construction until the 20-cycle failure fraction is shown to be at most 5% and the light yield is confirmed by simulation. If the failure data cannot be obtained, the brief's hard constraint cannot be shown to be met for any of the three designs.

Recommended coverage is 20%, within the 5-30% range. The choice rests on the prior 20% figure in the records.
